text.en: 1. These Rules are the Parking Places (Claims Against Forfeiture) Rules 2019 and come into operation on 3 January 2019.

3.—(1) For the purposes of section 15(5B) of the Act, a claim in respect of a vehicle removed to a place of safety or any other place must be accompanied by —
(a)documents which evidence the means by which the vehicle came into the ownership, or under the lawful possession, of the claimant before the vehicle was removed; and
(b)any other information specified by the Authority to decide on the particular claim.
(2) A document mentioned in paragraph (1) may be —
(a)provided in electronic form or in hardcopy; and
(b)an original document or a legible copy of the original document.
(3) Where a document mentioned in paragraph (1) is provided in the form of a copy (electronic or otherwise), the Authority may request the claimant to show the Authority the original document.
4. The Authority may refuse to consider a claim that is incomplete or not made in accordance with these Rules.
